purpose: Keep one stable D3D12 implementation compatible with inbox callers and multiple Agility SDK generations without mixing SDK payloads.

families.notes: The OS-selected D3D12 runtime path; required for games that do not opt into Agility.
DirectX 12 Ultimate and SM6.6-era caller behavior.
Representative patch for each public SDK version family; verify changed validation and barriers.
Includes retail Work Graphs/SM6.8, video, OMM, and tight-alignment history.
Includes Advanced Shader Delivery and state-database/cache behavior.
Authoritative stable release lane; includes SM6.9 and DXR 1.2 additions.
Separate opt-in preview lane for SM6.10 and other preview-only additions.

rules: The process-exported D3D12SDKVersion must match the selected Agility package family.
D3D12Core.dll and d3d12SDKLayers.dll must come from the same exact package version.
The translator must preserve older vtables, validation, layout, and error semantics while implementing the stable superset.
Feature reports are the intersection of caller SDK contract, host/provider capability, and passing behavior evidence.
Historical stable lanes are release blockers for compatibility; preview is never allowed to alter the stable result.
Every lane records exact package, header, runtime, loader-path, and provider hashes.

evidence.note: Microsoft's Agility SDK download page identifies 1.619.5 as the latest stable release and 1.721.3-preview as the latest preview at roadmap authoring time.
Microsoft documents D3D12SDKVersion/D3D12SDKPath selection and matching D3D12Core/D3D12SDKLayers requirements.
